about_the_game:
This is the offical walkthrough for Law School - Season 1. 

This guide is designed for players seeking assistance with their choices or aiming to unlock all available content.

With a optimized approach, find out what impact your choices will have on the story, and are the characters you interact with. 

Once downloaded, in the "Preferences" menu, you can activate or deactivate it. 

Please note, this walkthrough contains significant spoilers, so it’s recommended to experience the game without it on your first playthrough.

What this walkthrough provides: 

  • Coloured buttons to determine the type of choice you make

  • Tutorial as to how the walkthrough works

  • Will help you unlock all the fun facts, secret wallpapers, lewd scenes, and much more

content_descriptors.notes: This walkthrough is for a game that contains sexual scenes and mature content, which may not be suitable for all audiences. Viewer discretion is advised.
